message.text: The two protocols are gRPC-Gateway/REST and ConnectRPC. gRPC-Gateway/REST is registered in v1.go via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer. ConnectRPC is registered in connect_handler.go via NewMemoServiceHandler.

gRPC-Gateway (REST HTTP) is registered in v1.go via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer. Connect is registered in connect_handler.go via NewMemoServiceHandler.

Connect wrapping is in connect_services.go.

I am checking whether native gRPC is actually served. The APIV1Service embeds UnimplementedMemoServiceServer, but I have not found a grpc.Server instance yet.

gRPC-Gateway (REST HTTP JSON) — v1.go
Connect — connect_handler.go, connect_services.go

message.text:
gRPC-Gateway (REST) — server/router/api/v1/v1.go

Connect — registration in connect_handler.go, wrapping in connect_services.go; also wired from v1.go

q19.
gRPC-Gateway — server/router/api/v1/v1.go
Connect — server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go

`RegisterGateway` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` mounts REST via `RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`. Connect is registered with `NewMemoServiceHandler` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go`; `ConnectServiceHandler` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` wraps the same `APIV1Service` methods. There is no standalone gRPC server.
